purpose: Test whether Notebook 60's two positive gross long-selection differences remain economically useful when implemented as fully costed dollar-neutral residual portfolios.

authorization_and_provenance.precedent: Notebooks 59-60 found that 97.43% of the unchanged Notebook 36 hybrid's gross contribution came from the long leg and that its selected names beat equal-weight market and same-sector controls.
authorization_and_provenance.classification: user-authorized iterative retrospective strategy translation, not independent confirmation
authorization_and_provenance.prior_no_strategy_boundary_superseded_on: Notebook 60 prohibited costing its controls; the continuing user instruction to improve the strategy authorizes exactly this frozen two-arm economic translation. All other historical strategy searches remain closed.

unchanged_signal.source: Notebook 36 Gemma exact-event timing and counts with FinBERT ranking
unchanged_signal.universe: immutable original LSEG sector-33, three companies in each of 11 sectors
unchanged_signal.selected_long_weights: positive Notebook 36 target weights only; dates, eligibility, counts, names, weights, 25% cap, and one-session horizon unchanged
unchanged_signal.return_horizon: one-session split-adjusted open-to-open price return; dividends not back-adjusted
unchanged_signal.signal_reproduction: selected-long gross contribution must reproduce Notebook 60 within 1e-12

candidate_portfolios.market_residual: selected-long target minus an equal-weight target over all 33 names with identical total long notional
candidate_portfolios.sector_residual: selected-long target minus equal-weight three-name sector targets with identical selected-long notional inside every sector
candidate_portfolios.netting: combine signal and hedge weights by name before orders, turnover, costs, and returns
candidate_portfolios.scaling: no scaling up, leverage normalization, volatility targeting, or use of unused gross capacity
candidate_portfolios.inactive_sessions: cash when the unchanged selected-long target is inactive
candidate_portfolios.reference_only: Notebook 36 capped hybrid at 10 bps per side; its signal, weights, and prospective role remain unchanged

accounting.financing_borrow_spread_impact: not available; state as limitations rather than impute

primary_family: market_residual net return minus unchanged Notebook 36 capped hybrid net return
sector_residual net return minus unchanged Notebook 36 capped hybrid net return
inference.primary_method: two-sided paired circular moving-block bootstrap with BH over all four comparisons
inference.factor_method: OLS on equal-weight market plus ten sector-minus-market factors, HAC(5), with BH over the two intercept p-values
inference.temporal_stability: first-half and second-half net Sharpe and mean are descriptive predeclared gates; halves are not additional hypothesis tests

classification.retrospective_improvement: cash comparison and incumbent comparison both have positive means and BH q below 0.05, sector-spanning alpha is positive with BH q below 0.05, both half means are positive, break-even exceeds 10 bps per side, at least 60 sessions are active, and maximum absolute name weight is at most 25%
classification.costed_positive_not_improved: cash comparison passes and both half means are positive, but at least one retrospective-improvement condition fails
classification.nonviable: cash comparison fails or either half mean is nonpositive
